seo_defaults.delivery_hint: Serve with width/height attributes, lazy loading below the fold, fetchpriority=high on the LCP hero, and a responsive srcset.

notes: A negative savings_percent means the source file was already in a codec more efficient than WebP (AVIF) or was an extremely small JPEG thumbnail. The WebP is kept for format consistency; the untouched source is in _originals/.

images.alt_text: Children's Day celebration at Rithanya Hospital, Khammam, with staff and children posing for a group photo
images.title: Children's Day Celebration at Rithanya Hospital Khammam
images.caption: Staff and children celebrate Children's Day at Rithanya Hospital, Khammam, with a decorated stage, balloons and Telugu event banner.
images.description: A wide group photograph of more than forty smiling children seated and standing in rows, joined by hospital staff in white coats and women in bright saris, at a Children's Day function held at Rithanya Hospital in Khammam, Telangana. The hall is decorated with red, blue, yellow and gold balloons and a large pink Telugu banner announcing the celebration.
images.keywords: childrens day, kids event, community event, Rithanya Hospital, Khammam, children health, school children, telangana

images.alt_text: Main entrance and reception of Rithanya Hospital in Khammam with Telugu and English signage

images.caption: The main glass entrance of Rithanya Hospital, Khammam, displaying the hospital name board and reception counter inside.
images.description: Front elevation of the main entrance of Rithanya Hospital in Khammam, Telangana. Automatic sliding glass doors sit beneath a printed board reading 'Rithanya Hospital' in English and Telugu with the qualifications of Dr. D. Narayana Murthy. A red LED ticker above the doors scrolls the hospital name in Telugu, and an optometrist shop board is mounted on the pillar to the right.
images.keywords: hospital entrance, reception, Rithanya Hospital, Khammam, hospital facade, front desk, signage, telangana

images.alt_text: Outpatient waiting area and registration desk at Rithanya Hospital, Khammam

images.description: Interior view of the outpatient department waiting area at Rithanya Hospital, Khammam.
